merged_guidance.title: Consume the old batch before invoking a reentrant consumer
merged_guidance.applicability: A reusable deferred task invokes a synchronous save or consumer callback that can enqueue another value or flush reentrantly.
merged_guidance.event_relation: Capture the old value; retire that batch's pending state and timer before invoking its consumer. Work enqueued by that callback belongs to the next batch. Timer cancellation alone does not establish consumption.
merged_guidance.preservation: Consume the old value once. Outer cleanup must not erase callback-created work or consume it as the old batch. Preserve later reuse, valid empty values and the existing absence sentinel.
merged_guidance.exclusion: Saving is not a terminal state. Do not replace explicit None/null/nil sentinel checks with truthiness tests, or discard valid empty content.
merged_guidance.verification: Inside the consumer, enqueue another value and invoke nested flush. Check old-batch cardinality, survival of the new batch, its next deadline and successful later reuse.

record.title: Consume the old batch before invoking reentrant callbacks
record.applicability: A reusable deferred task invokes a synchronous consumer that can enqueue or flush work reentrantly.
record.event_relation: Capture the consumed value and retire its pending value and timer before invoking the consumer. Work enqueued by that callback belongs to a new batch.
record.preservation: Preserve reuse and empty values. Outer cleanup must neither consume the old batch twice nor erase callback-enqueued work.
record.exclusion: Use the existing absence sentinel; a truthiness check must not discard valid empty content. Timer cancellation alone is not a proof that pending state is consumed.
record.verification: Enqueue a new value and invoke nested flush inside a consumer; check old-batch cardinality, retention of new work and later successful consumption.

record.title: Consume batch state before invoking the save callback
record.applicability: A reusable task invokes its save callback synchronously, and that callback may edit again or flush the task.
record.event_relation: Capture the value to consume, clear that batch's timer and pending state, and then invoke saving. Edits created by synchronous callbacks belong to the next batch.
record.preservation: Preserve later reuse, avoid consuming the old value twice, and do not erase callback-created work during outer cleanup. Retain the existing absence sentinel.
record.exclusion: Do not make saving a terminal state. Do not replace None/null/nil checks with truthiness checks that discard valid empty strings.
record.verification: Edit again and invoke a nested flush inside the save callback. Check that the old batch saves once, the new batch remains pending and it completes at its next deadline.

obligation_checklist: Retain exact absence sentinel and valid empty values.
Retain nested flush cardinality and callback-created next batch.
